description: This source file contains functions related to boot process hooks, pivoting root filesystems, and overlay filesystem setup, primarily used during system initialization in embedded Linux environments.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_start
methods.description: Starts the splicing of hooks by setting a specific environment variable.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_finish
methods.description: Completes the splicing process by transferring hook functions and cleaning up environment variables.

methods.name: boot_hook_init
methods.description: Initializes a specific hook by appending it to the list of hooks.

methods.name: boot_hook_add
methods.description: Adds a function to a specific hook's list.

methods.name: boot_hook_shift
methods.description: Shifts the first function from a hook's function list and returns it.

methods.name: boot_run_hook
methods.description: Executes all functions associated with a specified hook.

methods.name: pivot
methods.description: Performs a pivot root operation, moving mount points to switch root filesystems.

methods.name: fopivot
methods.description: Sets up an overlay filesystem and pivots to it.

methods.name: ramoverlay
methods.description: Creates an in-memory overlay filesystem mounted on /tmp/root.
